entities.name: location
entities.description: Our heroes approach Drellin's Ferry after a long and perilous journey. They encounter a fierce hobgoblin ambush near an abandoned farmhouse, leading to a hard-fought battle where teamwork prevails. After interrogating a captured hobgoblin, they learn of Wyrmlord Koth's plans for 'the Day of Ruin' but are left with more questions than answers about the location of this impending threat.

entities.name: npc
entities.description: Bonnie, a named individual who is not a player character, warns the party about an ambush at an abandoned farmhouse. During a subsequent battle with hobgoblins, Bonnie interrogates a captured enemy but fails to extract information due to a Zone of Truth spell. The hobgoblin only answers under the condition that Olek, the Paladin, promises a swift death.

entities.name: npc
entities.description: Our heroes have arrived in Drellin's Ferry after a perilous journey. They encountered and defeated a group of hobgoblin warriors led by Norr near an abandoned farmhouse. After interrogating a captured hobgoblin named Norr, they learned about Wyrmlord Koth's plans for 'the Day of Ruin' but received little concrete information on the location of this event or how to stop it. Meanwhile, Olek and Bonnie attempted to warn a nearby family about an approaching danger, inadvertently causing panic with Olek's radiant appearance. Kaedin sought out Wizard Sertieren in his mansion overlooking the river, where he was greeted by a speaking fountain and engaged in conversation about mysterious happenings and magical sites within the Witchwood.

events.title: Crossing the Witchwood
events.description: The party travels through a dense forest, feeling an unsettling presence.

events.title: Abandoned Farmhouse Encounter
events.description: They discover an abandoned farmhouse and sense danger nearby, prompting Bonnie's warning.

events.title: Hobgoblin Ambush
events.description: A group of hobgoblins attacks the party in a surprise encounter on the road.

events.title: Battle Displayed Teamwork
events.description: The party fights off the hobgoblins, showcasing coordinated tactics and powerful magic.

events.title: Interrogation of Hobgoblin Captive
events.description: Bonnie attempts to interrogate a hobgoblin captive, but only receives cryptic answers about Wyrmlord Koth and the Day of Ruin.

events.title: Zone of Truth Interrogation
events.description: Olek casts a Zone of Truth to compel truthful answers, yet the hobgoblin remains silent until promising execution.

events.title: Promise and Retaliation
events.description: Olek agrees to execute the hobgoblin for three answers, but receives only vague information about Wyrmlord Koth.

events.title: Burning the Dead
events.description: Bonnie insists on burning the dead hobgoblins and any potential reanimated bodies to prevent future threats.

events.title: Townsfolk Encounter
events.description: Olek tries to warn a passing farmer's family about danger, but his divine appearance terrifies them into fleeing.

events.title: Child's Plea for Help
events.description: Olek and Bonnie encounter a child seeking help for his mother being hurt by her husband, leading to a moment of compassion.

events.title: Meeting Soranna at Tollhouse
events.description: Bonnie discreetly delivers an artifact to Soranna, who reveals information about a necromancer and the Dead Man's Boots.

events.title: Market Kindness
events.description: Norr and Soshi engage in small acts of kindness, purchasing goods from a few vendors despite being swindled by clever merchants.

events.title: Shrine Interaction
events.description: Norr and Soshi visit the Shrine of Pelor, where Brother Derny's enthusiastic but misguided offering attempt leads to a humorous exchange.

events.title: Druid Avarthel Consultation
events.description: Norr and Soshi consult with Druid Avarthel about the lake's location and associated dangers, learning of Vraath Keep within the Witchwood.

events.title: Mansion Encounter
events.description: Kaedin enters Sertieren's mansion, where a speaking fountain and halfling wizard engage him in conversation about his quest.

events.title: Wizard Sertieren's Rumblings
events.description: Kaedin learns from Sertieren about mysterious vanishings, Chronomancers of Kryn, and a magical nexus within the Witchwood.

events.title: Reunion at Meeting Point
events.description: All party members converge at the designated meeting point in Drellin's Ferry, ready to continue their quest with newfound information.
